messages.subject: link function for predictions
parts:
Dear INLA

I fit the following model with the last set of values for the response variable set to NA.

result = inla(formula,family = "poisson",data = data,control.compute = list(config = TRUE),control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),verbose=T)

However, the magnitude of the predictions (of NAs) is very different to the fitted values. Is this related to the link function for the Poisson? If so, please could you indicate how to ensure the log link is used for the predictions?

Many thanks for your help,
Rachel
